definitions.explanation: Individual words or short expressions in a text.

examples.japanese: ⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧{語句|ごく}
{語句|ごく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: To look up the meaning of words.

⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{適切|てきせつ}な→適切：01621_tekisetsu⟧{語句|ごく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

examples.english: I memorized the words and phrases from the English textbook one by one.

notes:
{語句|ごく} refers to words and short phrases, especially in the context of reading, studying, or writing. It is composed of {語|ご} (word) + ⟦{句|く}→句：02137_ku⟧ (phrase/clause).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {語句|ごく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧: meaning of words/phrases
- {語句|ごく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧: to look up words
- {語句|ごく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧: to memorize vocabulary
- ⟦{適切|てきせつ}な→適切：01621_tekisetsu⟧{語句|ごく}: appropriate wording

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{単語|たんご}→単語：03413_tango⟧: an individual word (the most common term for "word")
- ⟦{語彙|ごい}→語彙：14214_goi⟧: vocabulary (a collective set of words)
- ⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧: expression (broader, includes sentence-level phrasing)
- ⟦{用語|ようご}→用語：04086_yougo⟧: technical term, terminology

{語句|ごく} is somewhat formal and often appears in academic or literary contexts. In everyday conversation, ⟦{単語|たんご}→単語：03413_tango⟧ or ⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧ is more natural.

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse with ごく (⟦{極|ごく}→極：03816_goku⟧, extremely), which is an adverb.
